svg.title: Home rack switch front panels and cable endpoints
svg.desc: Stream is drawn above Brian but physically sits to its left. Brian above Jim above Dave, with palace several rack units below. Socket order follows the hardware; matching letter badges identify cable ends.
svg.text: Front views, top to bottom. Socket positions follow the hardware; spacing and chassis widths are schematic.

g.text: Physically left of brian; drawn above for cable routing
3 banks of 8 RJ45 · even above odd · SFP+ at right
4 QSFP28 cages · console above management at right
NIC endpoints only; rear-panel positions are not depicted

g.title: stream ETH0: wan — 1G connection to jim 21
stream ETH1: lan-jim — 1G connection to jim 6
stream SFP+ R: lan-dave — 10G connection to dave Q3.3
brian 6: Port 6 — Native VLAN 140; tagged VLAN 10
jim 1: ether1 — Configured member of shytzel-downlink
jim 2: ether2 — Configured member of shytzel-downlink
jim 3: ether3 — Configured member of shytzel-downlink
jim 4: ether4 — Configured member of shytzel-downlink
jim 10: castle — Backup attachment, normally down
jim 15: ether15 — lo access; peer unconfirmed
jim 16: ether16 — lo access; peer unconfirmed
jim 17: ether17 — lo access; peer unconfirmed
jim 18: ether18 — lo access; peer unconfirmed
jim 19: ether19 — lo access; peer unconfirmed
jim 20: ether20 — lo access; peer unconfirmed
jim S2: sfp-spare — 10G trunk; colony staging
dave Q4: qsfp28-4-1 — No identified peer

g.text: Matching letter badges identify cable ends. Port labels describe configured use; they do not indicate current link state.
